description: This file is a Lua test script for various features and behaviors of the Lua interpreter, including command-line options, environment variables, warning controls, error handling, signal interruption, and more.

methods.name: prepfile
methods.description: Creates or overwrites a file with specified content, either in text or binary mode.

methods.name: getoutput
methods.description: Reads the contents of the output file generated by the tests.

methods.name: checkprogout
methods.description: Checks that the program output matches the expected output, line by line.

methods.name: checkout
methods.description: Verifies that the actual output matches the expected string, asserting equality.

methods.name: RUN
methods.description: Runs a shell command with specified parameters, asserting its successful execution.

methods.name: NoRun
methods.description: Runs a shell command expecting it to fail, and checks that the output contains a specific message.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Transforms a given path string with semicolon replacements to test package path handling.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Sends an interrupt signal to a specified process ID.

methods.name: runback
methods.description: Runs a Lua script in background, returns its process handle and PID.
